SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Description IS NULL AND l.CRP LIKE '%+%';

SELECT m.molecule_id, CASE m.label WHEN '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN '-' THEN 'NO' END AS carcinogenic, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type IN ('2','3')) AS multiple_bond_count FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element IN ('P','Br'));

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio FROM schools WHERE County = 'Orange' AND StatusType = 'Merged';
SELECT schools.MailStreet, schools.School FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Description IS NULL AND l.CRP LIKE '%+%';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'n') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'n' AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#'));

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o_count), 4) AS avg_oxygen FROM (SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS o_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-') b LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id GROUP BY b.molecule_id);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(o.oxygen_count, 0)), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms FROM (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-') AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count FROM atom WHERE element = 'O' GROUP BY molecule_id) AS o ON s.molecule_id = o.molecule_id;
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 7;

WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,
         CASE WHEN m.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other' END AS role,
         COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS events_attended
  FROM member m
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, role
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN role = 'officer' THEN events_attended END), 2) AS officer_avg_events,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN role = 'other' THEN events_attended END), 2) AS other_avg_events
FROM member_counts;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength') AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1) AS avg_height_cm FROM superhero WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS ratio FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 0), max_ratio AS (SELECT MAX(ratio) AS max_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT er.event_name FROM event_ratios er JOIN max_ratio mr ON er.ratio = mr.max_ratio ORDER BY er.event_name;

SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength') AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength') AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL AND s.full_name <> '';

SELECT sch.School AS school_name, sch.MailStreet AS mailing_street FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.ALB), 4) AS avg_ALB FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.PLT > 400 AND LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female') AND UPPER(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%SLE%';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND eye_colour_id IS NULL;

WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS ratio FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 0) SELECT event_name FROM event_ratios WHERE ratio = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM event_ratios) ORDER BY event_name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  );

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS merged_unified_orange,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS merged_elementary_orange,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS ratio

         CASE WHEN m.position IN ('President','Vice President','Secretary','Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other' END AS grp,
         COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS events

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County, s.District, s.City, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count_k12, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS percent_eligible_frpm_k12, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumGE1500 FROM schools s LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a2.element IN ('P', 'Br'));

WITH member_attendance AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    CASE
      WHEN m.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'Officer'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS group_type,
    COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS event_count
  FROM member m
  LEFT JOIN attendance a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, group_type
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN group_type = 'Officer' THEN event_count END), 2) AS avg_events_per_officer,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN group_type = 'Other' THEN event_count END), 2) AS avg_events_per_other_student
